sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1202 — Mechanical Room Requirements
sources.description: Governs mechanical room location, sizing, ventilation, access, and fire-resistance requirements.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule VII — Mechanical Ventilation Requirements for Equipment Rooms
sources.description: Specifies minimum ventilation rates, temperature control, and combustion air requirements for mechanical and boiler rooms.

sources.label: NSCP 2015 — Seismic Bracing for Mechanical Equipment
sources.description: Requires seismic bracing and anchorage for mechanical equipment in Seismic Zone 4 including mechanical room equipment.
